title: dendrophthoe longiflora
intro: Dendrophthoe longiflora, commonly known as the mistletoe vine, is a hemiparasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the vascular system of its host plant, usually a tree. The health benefits of Dendrophthoe longiflora include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its use as an antihypertensive agent, an anti-inflammatory, and an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Dendrophthoe longiflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
